title: Dream and Refuge
medium: Seven colour lithograph on Somerset warm white velvet 400gsm paper

said.q: ‘Dream and Refuge’ (2020) was created at The Curwen Studio in London and is built up through seven separate coloured impressions. All proceeds from the sales are donated to The Nairobi Contemporary Art Institute (NCAI), a non-profit visual art space dedicated to the growth and preservation of contemporary art in East Africa.
